sources.entry: Kavita - Cross-platform e-book/manga/comic/pdf server and web reader with user management, ratings and reviews, and metadata support. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 .NET/Docker
Kavita | Reading server for manga, comics and ebooks

summary.one_liner: Kavita is a cross-platform reading server for manga, comics, and ebooks, with a web reader, user management, and optional paid Kavita+ features.
summary.what_it_does: Kavita serves manga, webtoons, comics (cbr, cbz, zip/rar/rar5, 7zip, raw images) and books (epub, pdf) from a self-hosted server. It includes responsive web readers meant for phones, tablets, and desktops, with webtoon and continuous reading modes and virtual pages for epub. Users are managed with role-based permissions for age restrictions and in-app abilities, and the README mentions OIDC. Content can be grouped into collections, reading lists (CBL import), and a want-to-read list, and filtered with metadata search and smart filters. The README also mentions customizable theming, full localization via Weblate, and epub annotation/highlighting. Metadata, reviews, ratings, recommendations, scrobbling, and smart collections are described as available through Kavita+.
use_cases: self-host a manga or comic library
share an ebook collection with family and friends
read comics and manga in a browser on any device
manage reading access with user accounts and age restrictions
organize books into collections and reading lists
read epub and pdf files from a web server
how_to_run: Follow the installation guides in the project wiki (the README points there for setup across install methods and platforms)
notable: Covers manga, webtoons, comics, and epub/pdf books in one server
Role-based user management with OIDC mentioned
Webtoon and continuous reading modes in the web reader
Reading lists with CBL import and a want-to-read list
caveats: README says it is beta software until the 1.0.0 release and data loss is possible
Metadata, reviews, ratings, recommendations, and scrobbling are tied to the paid Kavita+ subscription
Setup details are in the external wiki rather than the README
